system.description: Your physical action is impressive, inspiring an ally or intimidating a foe. After succeeding at a task that depends on brute force (such as smashing down a barred door, tearing open a locked container, lifting or moving a heavy object, or striking someone with a melee weapon), choose a creature who saw you succeed. If they are an ally, you ease their next task. If they are a foe, you can either hinder one of their tasks on their next turn or immediately attempt an eased intimidation task against them. Enabler.
